segments.name: Fastener
segments.description: Manufactures and sells rivets, cold-formed fasteners, components, and screw-machine products for automotive applications.
segments.evidence: This segment manufactures and sells rivets, cold‑formed fasteners and components, as well as screw‑machine products.

segments.name: Assembly Equipment
segments.description: Manufactures automatic rivet-setting machines and related parts, components, and tools used in such machines.
segments.evidence: The Assembly Equipment segment is primarily engaged in the manufacture of automatic rivet‑setting machines and related parts, components, and tools used in such machines.

revenueModel.text: Customers in the automotive industry and related suppliers purchase the Company's fasteners and assembly equipment products.
revenueModel.evidence: Revenues are primarily derived from sales to customers involved, directly or indirectly, in the manufacture of automobiles and automotive components.
